name: zjctl-agent-skill
description: Inspect local Zellij sessions and safely message terminal-based agents.

interface.longDescription: List Zellij sessions and tabs, inspect bounded pane output, observe activity, and send approved messages to verified terminal agents.
defaultPrompt: List the tabs in my elephc Zellij session.
Check the latest output for MySQLi in elephc.
Send my approved instructions to that agent.
